title: Social Media & Influencer
excerpt: Paid social, creators and content across Meta, TikTok and LinkedIn, measured on outcomes, never reach. Explore the service.
rm_desc: Our social media marketing agency runs paid social, creators and content, measured on outcomes. See the service.
content: As a social media marketing agency, we work on one premise: creative, creators and paid distribution have to run as one system with one scoreboard, or they compete with each other for the same budget. We plan platform strategy, produce and test content, manage creator partnerships and amplify with paid, measured on leads, sales and pipeline, never reach.
• Platform strategy and content across Meta, TikTok, LinkedIn and more
• Creator and influencer selection, management and performance tracking
• Paid social amplification and full-funnel campaigns
• Social commerce and livestream campaign support
• Dynamic creative testing with weekly winner selection

Launching a premium medical-grade skincare brand into three Southeast Asian markets on under 0.5% share of category spend, we grew GMV 168% through Shopee and Lazada in the first three months and brought 65,000 new visitors averaging 2 minutes 20 seconds with the content, after our customer-journey analysis rerouted the launch from a D2C site to the marketplaces where that category, in those markets, actually buys. The lesson generalises; the playbook does not: the same engagement ran a doctor-and-dermatologist B2B strategy in Singapore, because the channel follows the buyer, and buyers differ by market from one launch to the next. Advertisers in Malaysia can start with our practical guide to Facebook ads in Malaysia.
What our social media marketing agency will not do

On a global automotive marque’s regional campaign, programmatic video beat both YouTube and Meta direct buys decisively. We run social for a client because the numbers earn it, and move budget through paid media when they do not. The reverse also holds: for community-led and creator-led categories, social earns budget that search never could, because the buying decision itself gets made inside the feed. Channel answers are category answers.

Content production, community management, creator sourcing and paid amplification are billed as one connected retainer rather than four separate line items, because splitting them into vendors is exactly the fragmentation that makes social underperform in the first place. Meta’s ads guide and each platform’s own creative specs sit underneath the strategy; we build to them rather than around them, since ignoring platform-native formats is the fastest way to waste a paid social budget.
What a first month with our social media marketing agency looks like

Audit of existing channels and creative history first, so we are not repeating tests you have already run. Then a content and creator plan built against your actual funnel stage, not a generic calendar. Paid amplification starts once organic and creator content has something worth amplifying; spending on distribution before the creative is tested is how budgets get burned on the wrong asset at scale.
Who a social media marketing agency actually helps

Brands with something worth showing, a product, a process, a team, do better on social than brands trying to manufacture personality from nothing. If the account has no creative asset to build from, the first month’s job is finding one, not buying reach for a blank feed. That is a slower start than a media plan promising fast numbers, and it is the one that holds up past month three.

Followers and impressions go in the report because clients ask for them, not because they decide budget. The numbers that decide budget are cost per lead, assisted conversions from social touchpoints, and creator content that gets reused in paid, since content earning its keep twice changes the unit economics of the whole retainer, which is the actual argument for treating social as one connected system instead of a standalone line item on a media plan.
